target_note: Shared normal-CDF-skewed t target from the DCS experiment. The SCS paper uses a Student-t CDF and nu=1 or2; this applies its author algorithm/settings to our nu=3 target.
mse_note: All production iterations, including repeats after rejections; exact radial truth. Empirical bias squared plus between-chain variance with divisor number of chains equals MSE. More chains estimate error more precisely but cannot repair insufficient chain mixing.
